channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Saída de Girão acaba com racha no CE que gerou a briga de Michelle e Flávio
item.description: The announcement that Senator Eduardo Girão (Novo-CE) will be the vice-presidential candidate on the ticket led by former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo-MG) ends the major rift in Bolsonarism generated in Ceará, where Girão was a pre-candidate for state governor. His decision to withdraw from the gubernatorial race to join the national ticket unifies Bolsonarist forces in the state.

item.title: Lula faz aceno duplo a caminhoneiros e motoristas de aplicativo
item.description: President Lula will sign PLV nº 6/2026, which regulates transport operations, CIOT generation, and compliance with the National Minimum Freight Floor Policy, in a ceremony at 4 p.m. at the Planalto Palace. Later, at 5 p.m., he will meet with app-based drivers and taxi drivers to discuss the Move program, which offers reduced-interest loans for new or used vehicles, alongside Minister Guilherme Boulos.

item.title: Tenente Dalma é oficializada pelo PRTB como candidata à vice-presidência da República na chapa de Leonardo Avalanche
item.description: The Brazilian Labor Renewal Party (PRTB) officially nominated Lieutenant Dalma Regina Florencio de Morais as its vice-presidential candidate on the ticket with Leonardo Avalanche. The decision was unanimously approved by the party's National Executive Committee on August 3. Avalanche's presidential candidacy had been announced at a party convention on July 29, where he advocated for a single tax reform to reduce taxation and stimulate economic growth.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro deve anunciar vice nesta quarta
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a pre-candidate for President of Brazil, is expected to announce his running mate for vice president this Wednesday (5). He had previously set August 15 as the deadline for finalizing the ticket, the last day to register candidacies with the Electoral Justice. The announcement comes during his remote participation in a sabatina hosted by 'O Antagonista' and G4.

item.title: Governo Tarcísio diz que greve de ferroviários é baseada em "desinformação"
item.description: The government of Tarcísio de Freitas claims the railway workers' strike on CPTM lines 11-Coral, 12-Safira and 13-Jade is based on misinformation and harms nearly 1 million passengers, while contributing to over 720 km of traffic congestion in São Paulo. Workers defend the strike's legality under the Constitution, reject being labeled 'vagabonds,' and say they are fighting for their jobs and against privatizations. The government activated a contingency plan to reduce the strike's impacts.

item.title: Eleições 2026: TSE recebe lista de gestores públicos com contas julgadas irregulares
item.description: The TSE received from the TCU a list of over 6,1 thousand public officials with accounts judged irregular in the last eight years, 3% fewer than in 2024. Most cases involve former mayors and councilors from small towns, concentrated in the Northeast and Southeast regions. Of the 266 politically exposed individuals, there are 135 councilors, 1 councilors, 114 mayors, six state deputies, two federal deputies, and one senator (including alternates).

item.title: Embaixadora brasileira poderá ficar em Washington, dizem EUA
item.description: The U.S. State Department revoked the visa of Brazilian Ambassador Maria Luiza Viotti in Washington as a reciprocal measure due to Brazil's delay in granting agrément to Donald Trump's nominee for U.S. ambassador to Brasília. The department clarified it is not a persona non grata declaration but warned that if the ambassador leaves the U.S., she would need a new visa to return.

item.title: “Os únicos com coragem de combater os intocáveis”, diz Zema sobre Girão
item.description: Romeu Zema praised the official nomination of Eduardo Girão as his vice-presidential running mate, stating they are the only ones with courage to confront the 'to the elite', referring to Supreme Court justices. Zema commended Girão’s integrity, faith, and entrepreneurial success. The Novo ticket positions itself as a direct challenge to Brazil’s judiciary.

item.title: Lobista de Careca do INSS celebrou ida de Flávio Dino ao STF
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger, a lobbyist under investigation for possible influence peddling on behalf of Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes (Careca do INSS), celebrated Flávio Dino’s nomination to the STF in November 2023, praising him as honest, brave, and northeastern. She is a friend of Lulinha (Fábio Luís Lula da Silva) and is investigated for making payments of tens of thousands of reais to Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), former chief of staff to President Lula, who claims the transfers were a personal loan. Dino, appointed by Lula to replace Rosa Weber on the STF, currently oversees one of the investigations into Lulinha.

item.title: Sem precedentes, diz Ricupero após EUA revogar visto de embaixadora
item.description: Former minister Rubens Ricupero stated that the U.S. revocation of Brazil’s ambassador’s visa is an unprecedented act, likely retaliation for Brazil’s refusal to accept Daniel Perez as the U.S. nominee. He linked the move to broader diplomatic tensions, including the denial of visas to U.S. officials seeking to meet with presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, and warned that without resolution, both embassies could be led by chargés d’affaires.

item.title: Operação mira grupo suspeito de planejar ataque a Palácio do Planalto em outubro
item.description: Eight people were targeted in a search and seizure operation on suspicion of planning attacks against the Planalto Palace and other buildings on the Ministries Esplanade in October, during the 2026 electoral period. The police action aims to investigate potential threats to democratic institutions amid a sensitive phase of the electoral calendar.

item.title: Podemos decide por neutralidade nas eleições presidenciais
item.description: The Podemos party announced neutrality in the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections, joining other parties such as União Brasil, Progressistas (PP), and Republicans. The decision, communicated by party president Renata Abreu, aims to promote dialogue and concrete solutions amid political polarization. This stance disrupted negotiations with Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) campaign, which had been seeking Podemos’ support for a vice-presidential candidate but remains undecided as the registration deadline approaches.

item.title: MJ detalha operação para desarticular ataques a Brasília
item.description: The Ministry of Justice and Public Security detailed Operation Rede Interrompida, which dismantled a suspected group planning attacks in Brasília during the October electoral period, including invasions of public buildings and a bomb attack during electoral debates. The investigation began in June following Ciberlab monitoring of Telegram groups and involved police forces from five states, resulting in eight search and seizure warrants.

item.title: Lula evita ir à convenção de Leandro Grass para não desagradar PSB
item.description: Lula avoids attending Leandro Grass's (PT) convention in the Federal District to avoid displeasing the PSB, whose candidate, Cappelli, he appointed as federal intervener after the January 8 attacks. The move highlights tensions among Lula's allies in the local race, where PT and PSB, despite being national allies, field competing candidates. The Brazil of Hope Federation postponed its convention to August 5 to broaden the democratic and popular front supporting Grass.

item.title: Senado sedia exposição 'O Caminho do Voto', sobre etapas do processo eleitoral
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre attended the opening of the exhibition 'O Caminho do Voto', organized by the TSE, which illustrates the stages of Brazil's electoral process, from electronic voting machine development and testing to vote casting and result tabulation. The exhibition, hosted at the Espaço Senador Ivandro Cunha Lima, will be open until August 21, initially in the Senate and later moving to the Espaço da Praça das Abelhas, as part of National Electronic Voting System Week. The exhibit emphasizes the security and integrity of Brazil's electoral system, regarded as one of the most secure in the world.

item.title: Vera Lúcia é registrada pelo PSTU como candidata a governadora de SP e declara não ter bens
item.description: The PSTU has registered Vera Lúcia as its candidate for governor of São Paulo, with Renata França as her running mate. The sociologist declared before the TSE that she owns no assets, a shift from previous elections where she reported small holdings, such as R$8,800 in savings in 2022 and a R$20,000 land plot in 2020. This marks her fourth attempt to win an executive office in general elections, having previously run for president in 2018 and 2022, for governor of Sergipe in 2010, and for federal deputy in 2006 and 2014 — all without success.

item.title: Múcio diz que solução para invasão dos EUA seria ‘abrir o portão’
item.description: Defense Minister José Múcio stated that in the event of a hypothetical U.S. military invasion, Brazil should 'open the gate' due to lacking equipment and financial resources to resist, emphasizing that the current 1% of GDP allocated to defense is inadequate for long-term deterrence and technological development. His remarks contrast with President Lula’s recent rhetoric of national strength and sovereignty amid U.S.-Brazil diplomatic tensions, including the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations and Trump’s threats to seize Greenland, Canada, and the Panama Canal.

item.title: Mendonça nega remover vídeo de Flávio que associa PT ao PCC
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça denied a preliminary injunction request by the Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PCdoB, and PV) to take down a video posted by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) linking the PT to criminal factions PCC and CV. The ruling keeps the video online despite claims it defames the party and incites political hatred.

item.title: Aécio Neves desiste de disputar eleição pela primeira vez em 40 anos
item.description: Aécio Neves announced he will not run for any office in the 2026 elections, ending a 40-year streak of consecutive candidacies. Although well-positioned for the Senate in Minas Gerais, he chose to focus on leading the PSDB nationally and building a centrist political project, seeking to move beyond Lula-Bolsonaro polarization.

item.title: Lula sanciona lei que autoriza o STJ a suspender todos os processos sobre o mesmo tema até julgar o assunto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a law authorizing the Superior Court of Justice (STJ) to suspend nationwide all cases discussing the same legal issue until the court establishes a definitive ruling, equating its power to that of the STF in constitutional matters. The law requires that a resource demonstrate economic, political, social, or legal relevance beyond the parties' interests to be reviewed by the STJ, and a lack of relevance will require a two-thirds vote of the court's members. The suspension will last up to six months, with a possible single extension, and will apply to all cases involving the same controversy, regardless of the parties involved.

item.title: Revogar visto de embaixadora nos EUA é incomum, diz Senado
item.description: Senator Nelsinho Trad (PSD-MS), president of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, stated that the revocation of the visa of Brazil’s ambassador to the U.S., Maria Luiza Viotti, by the U.S. government is an unusual measure tied to Brazil’s delay in approving the agrément for U.S. ambassador Daniel Perez. He clarified that the move does not constitute a formal persona non grata declaration and urged preservation of diplomatic dialogue, citing over 200 years of Brazil-U.S. relations.

item.title: União Brasil decide pela neutralidade na eleição presidencial
item.description: União Brasil announced national neutrality in the 2026 presidential election, allowing its candidates to form state-level coalitions as they see fit. The party, which formed a federation with the Progressistas (PP) in March, follows PP’s earlier neutral stance declared on July 31. Party president Antonio Rueda stated the decision reflects the federation’s political maturity.

item.title: Assexual? Candidatura de Luís Fabiano à Câmara dos Deputados surpreende por orientação sexual
item.description: Luís Fabiano, former Brazilian national team striker, officially registered his candidacy for federal deputy from São Paulo under the MDB party, surprising the public by listing his sexual orientation as asexual. The party stated it was a registration error and that the information will be corrected. Although his candidacy was previously announced, the detail attracted significant public attention.

item.title: Crusoé: A experiência de Renan Santos no setor privado
item.description: Tallis Gomes, businessman from the G4 group, questioned Renan Santos' private sector experience, claiming he never signed a relevant payroll or held managerial responsibility despite years of criticizing government officials. The statement was made during an interview with O Antagonista and sparked social media debate over Renan's qualifications for the presidency.

item.title: Trump dobra aposta em interferência e revoga visto de embaixadora do Brasil em Washington
item.description: The United States revoked the visa of Brazil's ambassador to Washington, Maria Luiza Ribeiro Viotti, as pressure for the Lula government's delay in approving the arrival of the new U.S. ambassador, Daniel Perez. The move, equivalent to diplomatic expulsion, occurs amid rising tensions, with Washington claiming Brazil is delaying the agrément process, despite having nominated Perez before seeking Brazilian approval — a breach of diplomatic protocol. The Brazilian government views the action as part of a strategy to interfere in the 2026 elections, particularly due to Trump and Rubio's support for Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Aécio Neves decide não disputar eleições este ano
item.description: Aécio Neves announced he will not run in the 2026 elections, ending a 40-year streak of consecutive mandates. The former governor of Minas Gerais, ex-senator, and current federal deputy said he will focus entirely on strengthening the PSDB’s caucus in the Chamber of Deputies, aiming to grow it from 17 to 30 members. Allies say he believes that regardless of the 2026 presidential outcome — especially if Lula wins — there will be room in 2030 for the PSDB to emerge as an alternative to both petism and bolsonarism.

item.title: Integrantes do Itamaraty veem retaliação e medida política dos EUA com revogação de visto de embaixadora brasileira
item.description: Brazilian Foreign Ministry officials view the revocation of Ambassador Maria Luiza Viotti's U.S. visa as a political move by the Trump administration amid rising diplomatic tensions, potentially retaliatory for Brazil's hesitation in approving Daniel Perez's nomination as U.S. ambassador to Brasília. The announcement was preemptively made by bolsonarist blogger Paulo Figueiredo, fueling suspicions that the move aims to influence Brazil's 2026 elections in favor of Flávio Bolsonaro, despite President Lula leading in polls.

item.title: Com Girão na vice de Zema, Novo terá chapa pura para a Presidência
item.description: The New Party officially nominated Senator Eduardo Girão as vice-presidential candidate on the ticket with Romeu Zema, forming a pure party slate. This follows failed talks with Joaquim Barbosa and earlier speculation that Zema might run as Flávio Bolsonaro’s running mate. The PSD and Missão parties will also field pure slates in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: TSE divulga representatividade partidária para tempo de propaganda gratuita nas Eleições 2026
item.description: The TSE released the party representativity table for free electoral propaganda on radio and TV and debate participation in the 2026 elections, based on TSE Ordinance No. 473. The União Progressista Federation (União Brasil and PP) leads with 104 federal deputies, followed by the PL (98) and the Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PCdoB and PV) with 81. The calculation includes only parties and federations meeting the requirements of Constitutional Amendment No. 97/2017 (Performance Clause).

item.title: Caiado diz que neutralidade do Republicanos expõe desgaste de Flávio e critica protagonismo de Milei
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that the Republicanos party's neutrality in the 2026 presidential race reflects the weakening of Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign due to recent controversies. He also criticized the PL's national convention, arguing that Javier Milei's prominence and an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro overshadowed Flávio, undermining his ability to build a broad coalition and reducing the likelihood of Daniella Marques being chosen as his running mate.

item.title: Greve em SP: Ferroviários dão prazo de 1h para proposta de Tarcísio
item.description: The Central Brazil Railway Workers' Union gave São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas a one-hour ultimatum to respond to strike demands, as three CPTM lines remain partially paralyzed since Tuesday morning. Workers demand job security and deny political motives, while the governor claims the strike is politically motivated to harm passengers and cites government investments in rail improvements.

item.title: Campanha de Lula enfrenta escalada de crise entre Polícia Federal, STF e cúpula do PT; leia bastidor
item.description: Lula's campaign is facing an internal crisis after revelations that Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, his former chief of staff known as 'Marcola', received payment from businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger, who is under investigation by the Federal Police for alleged influence-peddling involving Lula's son, Lulinha. STF ministers, including André Mendonça, accuse the PF of obstructing investigations for electoral reasons, while PT leaders debate whether Marcola should step down from campaign coordination to avoid the corruption scandal tarnishing the government's image, especially with Lula's rejection at 46% in the latest Datafolha poll.

item.title: A República dos sem explicação
item.description: Columnist Fernando Schüler alleges a suspicious financial network involving Lula’s former chief of staff Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro ('Marcola'), businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger — friend of Lulinha and tied to the 'INSS Careca' — and politicians like Jaques Wagner and Flávio Bolsonaro. He argues the absence of transparent explanations for loans, contracts, and investments is turning Brazil into a 'Republic of No Explanations', undermining government credibility and the 2026 presidential campaign.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Quem ganhou e quem perdeu na sabatina de O Antagonista e G4?
item.description: In the Papo Antagonista interview hosted by O Antagonista and G4, candidates Romeu Zema, Ronaldo Caiado, Renan Santos, and Flávio Bolsonaro participated, while Lula was invited but declined. The discussion covered topics such as security, economy, and foreign policy, with varying performances based on each candidate's proposals and demeanor.

item.title: Crusoé: Reforma do STF une candidatos da direita em sabatina
item.description: Four presidential candidates participating in a sabatina hosted by O Antagonista and G4 in São Paulo all addressed the need for reform or criticized the Supreme Federal Court (STF). Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) spoke most extensively on the topic, reinforcing his stance through a social media series titled 'Os...'. The STF agenda united right-wing candidates around a shared critique of judicial power.

item.title: Quem é Maria Viotti, embaixadora que teve o visto cancelado pelos EUA
item.description: Maria Luiza Viotti, the first woman to lead Brazil's Embassy in the United States, had her visa revoked by the Trump administration on August 4, 2025. She had held the post since 2023 following nomination by President Lula and Senate approval, and brings nearly five decades of diplomatic experience, including roles at the UN, in Germany, and as chief of staff to UN Secretary-General António Guterres. The Itamaraty was not previously informed of the U.S. decision.

item.title: TSE divulga critérios de divisão de tempo para propaganda eleitoral de rádio e TV
item.description: The TSE has released the criteria for allocating free electoral advertising time on radio and TV for the 2026 elections, based on party representation in the Chamber of Deputies. 90% of the time will be distributed proportionally to federal deputies elected in 2022, while 10% will be equally divided among parties that surpassed the performance threshold. Electoral advertising begins on August 28, but individual candidate time will only be calculated after August 15, the deadline for formal candidacy registration.

item.title: Trump cancela visto de embaixadora do Brasil em Washington
item.description: The U.S. State Department revoked the visa of Brazil's ambassador to Washington, Maria Luiza Ribeiro Viotti, in response to the Brazilian government's delay in approving Daniel Perez as U.S. ambassador to Brazil. The Lula administration had postponed granting agrément to Perez until after the 2026 presidential runoff, contrary to U.S. expectations. The move also followed Brazil's denial of visas to two U.S. State Department officials seeking to discuss electoral matters, after Flávio Bolsonaro raised concerns about electronic voting machine security.

item.title: Assista à desmontagem da urna eletrônica e entenda o sistema de votação
item.description: The TSE conducted the first live disassembly of an electronic voting machine to showcase its internal operation, emphasizing security layers such as encryption, digital signatures, dedicated security processors, and no internet, Wi-Fi, or Bluetooth connectivity. The broadcast included the issuance of the zero report and ballot bulletin, accessibility features, and contingency protocols, reinforcing confidence in the electronic voting system.

item.title: Lobista que deu dinheiro a assessor de Lula deve mais de meio milhão de reais ao fisco
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger, a businesswoman and lobbyist identified by the Federal Police as the source of a payment to Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), former chief of staff to President Lula, owes over R$500,000 in taxes. Her company, RL Consultoria e Intermediações S.A., shows evidence of a R$531,770.46 tax debt. Marcola confirmed receiving the amount, claiming it was a personal loan already repaid, while the PF investigates potential links between Lulinha, the president’s son, and the government.

item.title: Mendonça rejeita retirar do ar vídeo de Flávio Bolsonaro que associa PT ao PCC e ao CV com uso de IA
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça denied a request to remove a video by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro that links the PT to criminal factions PCC and CV using AI, ruling it as political speech protected under democratic debate, despite being exaggerated, due to insufficient evidence of specific criminal attribution or imminent harm at this stage.

item.title: ‘Reagiu, morreu’, diz Renan Santos sobre polícias e combate ao crime
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party, argued that police should be allowed to use lethal force against criminals who resist arrest, even if the victim has already surrendered, citing the killing of cyclist Vitor Medrado as an example. He stated that those who surrender will be arrested, but those who resist or confront police may be killed, rejecting any 'third alternative'.

item.title: Governo Trump revoga visto da embaixadora do Brasil nos EUA
item.description: The United States revoked the visa of Brazil's ambassador, Maria Luiza Ribeiro Viotti, after Brazil refused to grant agrément to the U.S.-nominated ambassador, Daniel Perez, amid escalating diplomatic tensions. The move does not entail expulsion but follows Brazil's denial of visas to Trump administration officials seeking to discuss elections in the country. The visa could be reinstated if Brazil approves Perez's nomination, which awaits a vote in the U.S. Senate floor.

item.title: União Brasil anuncia neutralidade na eleição presidencial
item.description: União Brasil announced it will remain neutral in the 2026 presidential election, allowing its coalition with the PP, União Progressista, to support presidential candidates based on regional and local alliances. The PP and Republicanos also declared neutrality, with Podemos expected to follow, complicating Flávio Bolsonaro’s efforts to build a Centrão coalition.

item.title: Marcos Pontes quer vice de Flávio: ‘Sou piloto de caça pronto para missão’
item.description: Senator Marcos Pontes (PL-SP) offered himself as a running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in the 2026 presidential election, emphasizing his background as a fighter pilot and his ability to attract technocratic and Northeastern voters. He argued that his candidacy would help move Flávio toward the center and increase TV airtime, especially if no cross-party alliance is possible. Despite Flávio’s preference for a woman and a Northeasterner, Pontes noted that Michelle Bolsonaro’s presence already addresses gender balance and that he has deep familiarity with the Northeast’s challenges and potential.

item.title: Dani Lima: Empréstimo de amiga de Lulinha deixa Lula com gosto de traição
item.description: Columnist Dani Lima states that the loan received by Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, from Roberta Luchsinger — a friend of Fábio Luiz Lula da Silva (Lulinha) — left President Lula with a feeling of betrayal. According to her, Lula was left with 'a very bitter taste in the mouth of betrayal'.

item.title: Tarcísio e Haddad irão a debate da Band para o governo de SP
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT) will participate in the first debate of the São Paulo gubernatorial campaign, scheduled for Sunday (9) on TV Band. The encounter will be the first direct confrontation between the two leading candidates in the state race.

item.title: União Brasil oficializa neutralidade e não vai apoiar Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: União Brasil declared neutrality in the 2026 presidential elections, allowing its members to support candidates based on state-level scenarios. The decision, made at a national convention, reinforces the federation’s independence from the Progressistas and avoids endorsing Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The party also authorized its national executive to adjust majoritarian tickets until the candidacy registration deadline.

item.title: Nunes Marques manda governo retirar publicações que promovem Lula
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, ordered the federal government to remove, within 48 hours, official publications promoting President Lula’s personal actions, deeming them inappropriate institutional propaganda. The ruling aims to prevent the use of public resources for electoral purposes, ensuring fairness ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Kassio aponta propaganda velada e manda governo remover conteúdos de canais oficiais em 24 horas
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques ordered the Presidency to remove within 24 hours any official content constituting veiled institutional publicity that highlights President Lula. The ruling aims to ensure electoral fairness in 2026 by preventing the use of public resources for personal promotion. The decision was issued on April 8, 2026, at 5:13 PM.
